CustomField.description:
S3P-1372 - Created
Created with the agreement that we would review this for deletion about 90 days after creation. CS Reps will be asked to fill out this information so we can verify the accuracy of Customer Health Score against their general impressions. There is no long-term plan for keeping this data up to date.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The color that best represents Customer Support's impression of this customer's health. This manual rating will be used to benchmark and fine-tune our automated Customer Health Score calculations. Note: This field is intended to be used temporarily for data validation and may be removed (or become inaccurate) following the initial CHS testing and review period.
CustomField.label: CHS - CS Assessment
